name: Telnyx SMS
description: Send and receive SMS/MMS via Telnyx Messaging API

defaultFromNumber.description: Default phone number to send from

allowFrom.description: Phone numbers allowed to message the bot

publicKey.description: Base64 Ed25519 public key for verifying Telnyx webhooks. Copy from https://portal.telnyx.com/#/account/public-key — organization-wide, same key for SMS/Voice/Verify.

overwriteExistingWebhook.description: If the Telnyx profile already has a different webhook URL, overwrite it instead of failing safe. Default: false.

profileName.description: Name to use when auto-creating a Telnyx messaging profile. Defaults to the agent id.

autoCreateProfile.description: Explicit opt-in: if the Telnyx account has no messaging profile, create one and attach an orphan number. Default false — plugin logs what it would do and waits for you to opt in. Profile creation is visible in your Telnyx dashboard + billing.
